svg.title: Greenhouse grower — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as greenhouse grower, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Two young plants grow from a raised nutrient trough beneath two separate dripper outlets. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a tapered face.
